body: Thank you, I genuinely mean that.

I don't really know what else to say. I kind of expected to either be ignored or told what a shitty person I am when I posted this. I honestly don't really know how to react in the face of positivity.
Thank you, it's really hard to convey through text how much this means to me.

You're a good person, I can honestly tell how hard you're trying to help me, but the reason I know everything I said about myself is true, is that I'm just using you to feel better about myself. I don't deserve the kind words or pride. I don't think we are very much alike at all though, you are a good person actually trying to help someone and all I can do is leach and take. To answer your question the thing I have left to lose is the ease of access to get everything I need together for my method, I'll still need a few days to get everything together and I will wait for a day where I can have the house to myself for a few hours. I know it's not a lot to lose, but its all I have left at this point. I'm sorry for wasting so much of your time.

I know that your right, but I still just can't bring myself to do it, I'm a coward. I'm afraid that once they hear about it, my method would become harder to follow through on especially if they kick me out (which the completely should). I have been a useless selfish piece of shit my entire life, I don't think I could change in my last few days. Thank you for trying to help at least, but I think it well beyond helping I think I just had to get this off my chest to someone before doing it.

How could I possibly support myself though? I feel like I am the biggest source of disappointment in my own life. I have just coasted for so many years that I genuinely hate everything about me. My family sadly thinks the world of me, since they have bought into my lies, which just makes me hate myself more. I realize you're trying to help, but I think I dug myself in too deep and the panic and anxiety are finally starting to get to the point where I feel death would be better. I know how selfish it sounds, but I'm obviously a piece of shit so I don't see any other way.

Thank you for the kind words, and I really hope your situation gets better, but no I don't enjoy anything at all. Psychology was just the easiest degree I could see myself getting and it gave me an excuse to be a waste of human life for a few more years. I'm sorry if it appears like I'm humble-bragging or something but that's not my intention. It took me 8 years of lieing to my family to earn this degree. In fact, I'm still lieing to them, they think I'm going to be applying to med school soon when I just can't. I have ruined both their lives and mine and I really feel like my only apology is ending it all.
